paper_title: Entanglement Spectrum Resolved by Loop Symmetries (Yagi, 2025, arXiv)
core_reasoning_1:
\section*{Claim}
For a finite group $G$, a closed oriented loop $\ell$, and irreducible representations $\alpha,\beta\in \operatorname{Rep}(G)$, the diagonal loop operators
\[
\Lambda_\ell^\alpha:=\sum_{\{g\}_\ell}\chi_\alpha(h(\{g\}_\ell))\,|\{g\}_\ell\rangle\langle \{g\}_\ell|
\]
satisfy the fusion law
\[
\Lambda_\ell^\alpha\Lambda_\ell^\beta=\sum_{\gamma\in\operatorname{Rep}(G)}N_{\gamma}^{\alpha\beta}\Lambda_\ell^\gamma.
\]

\section*{Premises}
\begin{align*}
(P1)\;&G\text{ is a finite group and }\operatorname{Rep}(G)\text{ is the set of irreducible representations of }G.\\
(P2)\;&\chi_\alpha(g):=\operatorname{Tr}D^\alpha(g)\text{ is the character of }\alpha.\\
(P3)\;&h(\{g\}_\ell):=g_1^{s_1}g_2^{s_2}\cdots g_m^{s_m}\in G,\qquad s_i\in\{1,-1\}.\\
(P4)\;&\Lambda_\ell^\alpha:=\sum_{\{g\}_\ell}\chi_\alpha(h(\{g\}_\ell))\,|\{g\}_\ell\rangle\langle \{g\}_\ell|.\\
(P5)\;&\langle \{g\}_\ell|\{k\}_\ell\rangle=\delta_{\{g\}_\ell,\{k\}_\ell}.\\
(P6)\;&\chi_\alpha(u)\chi_\beta(u)=\chi_{\alpha\otimes\beta}(u)=\sum_{\gamma\in\operatorname{Rep}(G)}N_\gamma^{\alpha\beta}\chi_\gamma(u),\qquad u\in G.
\end{align*}

\section*{Derivation}
\begin{align*}
\Lambda_\ell^\alpha\Lambda_\ell^\beta
&=\left(\sum_{\{g\}_\ell}\chi_\alpha(h(\{g\}_\ell))|\{g\}_\ell\rangle\langle\{g\}_\ell|\right)
  \left(\sum_{\{k\}_\ell}\chi_\beta(h(\{k\}_\ell))|\{k\}_\ell\rangle\langle\{k\}_\ell|\right) &&\text{by (P4)}\\
&=\sum_{\{g\}_\ell}\sum_{\{k\}_\ell}\chi_\alpha(h(\{g\}_\ell))\chi_\beta(h(\{k\}_\ell))
  |\{g\}_\ell\rangle\langle\{g\}_\ell|\{k\}_\ell\rangle\langle\{k\}_\ell| &&\text{multiply sums}\\
&=\sum_{\{g\}_\ell}\chi_\alpha(h(\{g\}_\ell))\chi_\beta(h(\{g\}_\ell))
  |\{g\}_\ell\rangle\langle\{g\}_\ell| &&\text{by (P5)}\\
&=\sum_{\{g\}_\ell}\left(\sum_{\gamma\in\operatorname{Rep}(G)}N_\gamma^{\alpha\beta}\chi_\gamma(h(\{g\}_\ell))\right)
  |\{g\}_\ell\rangle\langle\{g\}_\ell| &&\text{by (P6)}\\
&=\sum_{\gamma\in\operatorname{Rep}(G)}N_\gamma^{\alpha\beta}
  \sum_{\{g\}_\ell}\chi_\gamma(h(\{g\}_\ell))|\{g\}_\ell\rangle\langle\{g\}_\ell| &&\text{reorder finite sums}\\
&=\sum_{\gamma\in\operatorname{Rep}(G)}N_\gamma^{\alpha\beta}\Lambda_\ell^\gamma &&\text{by (P4).}
\end{align*}

\section*{Final Result}
\[
\boxed{\Lambda_\ell^\alpha\Lambda_\ell^\beta=\sum_{\gamma\in\operatorname{Rep}(G)}N_\gamma^{\alpha\beta}\Lambda_\ell^\gamma}
\]
\hfill$\blacksquare$
core_reasoning_13:
\section*{Claim}
For a normalized gauge-invariant loop-symmetric state whose topological coefficient matrix is
\[
\bigoplus_{[\varphi]\in\operatorname{Im}/G^{|A|}}\mathbf{1}_{|[\varphi]|}\otimes
\left(\bigoplus_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}\Psi_{\alpha}\otimes\mathbf{1}_{d_\alpha}\right),
\]
let $|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2$ be the eigenvalues of $\Psi_\alpha\Psi_\alpha^\dagger$ and let
\[
N:=\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2.
\]
Then the entanglement entropy is
\[
S=|V_\partial|\ln |G|-|A|\ln |G|-
\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha
\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}\ln\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}.
\]

\section*{Premises}
\begin{align*}
(P1)\;&q:=|G|^{|V_\partial|-|A|}.\\
(P2)\;&\rho_X=q^{-1}\mathbf{1}_q\otimes\rho',\qquad \operatorname{Tr}\rho'=1.\\
(P3)\;&S(\rho):=-\operatorname{Tr}(\rho\ln\rho).\\
(P4)\;&\ln(a^{-1}b)=\ln b-\ln a\text{ for positive scalar }a\text{ and positive eigenvalue }b.\\
(P5)\;&\rho'\text{ has eigenvalues }p_{[\varphi],\alpha,i}:=|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2/N\text{ with multiplicity }|[\varphi]|d_\alpha.\\
(P6)\;&N:=\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2.\\
(P7)\;&\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}p_{[\varphi],\alpha,i}=1.
\end{align*}

\section*{Derivation}
Using the spectrum of a tensor product with a normalized identity factor,
\begin{align*}
S(\rho_X)
&=-\operatorname{Tr}\left(q^{-1}\mathbf{1}_q\otimes\rho'\right)
\ln\left(q^{-1}\mathbf{1}_q\otimes\rho'\right) &&\text{by (P2),(P3)}\\
&=-\sum_{a=1}^{q}\sum_{\lambda\in\operatorname{spec}(\rho')}q^{-1}\lambda\ln(q^{-1}\lambda) &&\text{eigenvalues of }q^{-1}\mathbf{1}_q\otimes\rho'\\
&=-\sum_{a=1}^{q}\sum_{\lambda}q^{-1}\lambda(\ln\lambda-\ln q) &&\text{by (P4)}\\
&=-\sum_{\lambda}\lambda\ln\lambda+\ln q\sum_{\lambda}\lambda &&\text{sum over }a=1,\ldots,q\\
&=-\operatorname{Tr}(\rho'\ln\rho')+\ln q &&\text{because }\operatorname{Tr}\rho'=1\\
&=-\operatorname{Tr}(\rho'\ln\rho')+(|V_\partial|-|A|)\ln|G| &&\text{by (P1).}
\end{align*}
Expanding $-\operatorname{Tr}(\rho'\ln\rho')$ with the multiplicities in (P5),
\begin{align*}
-\operatorname{Tr}(\rho'\ln\rho')
&=-\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha
\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}p_{[\varphi],\alpha,i}\ln p_{[\varphi],\alpha,i} &&\text{by (P5)}\\
&=-\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha
\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}\ln\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}. &&\text{substitute }p_{[\varphi],\alpha,i}
\end{align*}
Combining the preceding two displayed equations yields
\begin{align*}
S(\rho_X)
&=(|V_\partial|-|A|)\ln|G|-
\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha
\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}\ln\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N} &&\text{substitution}\\
&=|V_\partial|\ln|G|-|A|\ln|G|-
\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha
\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}\ln\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}. &&\text{distribute }\ln|G|
\end{align*}

\section*{Final Result}
\[
\boxed{S=|V_\partial|\ln |G|-|A|\ln |G|-
\sum_{[\varphi]}|[\varphi]|\sum_{\alpha\in\operatorname{Rep}(G_\varphi)}d_\alpha
\sum_{i=1}^{x_\alpha}\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}\ln\frac{|\psi_{\alpha,i}|^2}{N}}
\]
\hfill$\blacksquare$
